scope: Narrow isolation of synthetic dpkg source-builder invocations and preparation/evidence wiring in all three CI consumers
findings: Only the fixture devscripts wrapper real -S subprocess is containerized. The genuine dpkg-buildpackage/source metadata generation execute in Ubuntu; host dch/tar, real host dpkg-source extraction, binary strip tests, and other suites retain their prior context.
The fixture image is built from the existing committed immutable Ubuntu 22 base and authenticated fixed archive snapshot. The unrelated frozen P003 toolchain recipe is unchanged.

Preparation requires an empty output directory, fails on build/probe/identity/OS/package errors, and publishes image-id.txt only after all checks. Original build log, image inspection, OS and package inventory, recipe hash, lock hash and immutable image ID are retained.
All three consuming jobs require the image explicitly. Missing or failed configured Docker execution cannot fall back to the native builder.

The source invocation uses --pull never, host UID:GID, network none, a read-only root, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, private writable /tmp, clean container PATH, and the complete fixture-base bind. All sibling package artifacts and the isolated status database remain available.
The real Ubuntu vendor policy runs in a genuinely clean filesystem. No vendor hook or taint result is replaced; no host SDK tree is removed, renamed, hidden or prewarmed.
An owned UUID container name is explicitly cleaned before temporary files. Timeout and cleanup failures remain test failures; the real source-builder deadline is still 60 seconds.
All ten preexisting test-method ASTs, source artifact/extraction assertions, and run_script helper are unchanged from A3. Two explicit missing-image/launch-failure negative cases are added.

All unrelated jobs in the three workflows are semantically unchanged. Every preexisting legacy build-dsc step, including the full real production source build and original artifact collection/upload, is unchanged.
P003/P004 original artifact paths retain image metadata; legacy source CI retains a separate 90-day metadata artifact. Normal P004 suite/log/receipt validation remains in force.

boundary_coverage: Generated shim actual argv and launch-error propagation
Timeout failure retains output and owned cleanup precedes temp deletion
Cleanup daemon error is not swallowed
Successful preparation binds original logs/recipe to checked immutable image
Build error/wrong image/wrong OS/missing package never publish usable image ID
Previous output is preserved and refused before Docker
static_checks: All three workflow YAML parse and unrelated-job equality
All prior test methods/assertions/deadline AST equality

limitations: Docker is unavailable in this workspace. No actual container image build or isolated dpkg execution was performed locally; boundary probes use explicitly mocked Docker.
First fresh hosted container invocation, all source/package suites, and original artifacts must pass on the final source. This review cannot establish P004 acceptance.

The original hosted process is observed to stall at dpkg-genbuildinfo; the /usr/local recursive scan is strongly corroborated by vendor code and runner-image issue 13150 but was not directly traced in the failing runner.
provenance: Repository interfaces, captured original CI failure, installed/public Debian tooling, official GitHub/Docker documentation. No restricted Apple or crypto source accessed.
